map.悬臂梁均布载荷挠度：δ = w·L⁴ ÷ (8·E·I)（自由端，×1000 化: Cantilever uniform-load deflection: δ = w·L⁴ ÷ (8·E·I) (free end, scaled ×1000 to mm); solid circular-section second moment of area I = π·d⁴ ÷ 64 (m⁴). Validation: w, L, E and d must be non-empty. Criterion: no fixed grading—deflection is proportional to the load and the fourth power of the beam length, and inversely proportional to the fourth power of the diameter.
